description: Several model loops, each with its own prompt, tools and history, that pass work, control or state between them.
A planner splits a task into subtasks at runtime, workers handle them (often in parallel) and the orchestrator synthesizes the results.
A tool call that transfers control of the conversation from one agent to another peer agent.
Peer agents that coordinate through handoffs or shared state without a central planner. More flexible, less predictable. `emerging`.
Shared state that several agents read and write, with rules for who may write what and how conflicts resolve.
The module's checkpoint: single agent or multi-agent per feature from measured numbers, plus limits, budgets, validation and protocols.
